dedupe_keys.name: stacje ciagłych pomiarow ruchu scpr continuous traffic counting stations on polish national roads

description: GDDKiA, Poland's General Directorate for National Roads and Motorways, runs continuous traffic counting stations (Stacje Ciągłych Pomiarów Ruchu, SCPR) on the national road network. Continuous counting in Poland dates from the 1970s. Coverage: about 200 counting sites or cross-sections recording all year, using loop-detector counters that classify vehicles into 8 or 6 categories depending on the device; GDDKiA also processes other traffic data sources. Data are checked continuously, and a yearly report summarises the whole system and its results. The Traffic Measurement and Analysis Division of the Department of Strategy and Studies supervises the stations. Format and access: the page gives a station location map (as of 20 May 2026), the annual summaries and technical and siting requirements for stations. Licence and cost: free; gov.pl text is CC BY-SA 4.0, and no data licence was found. Caveats: raw station series are not offered as open files on the page; users see summaries. The results give seasonal and hourly factors for expanding short counts in road network flow and capacity models. It relates to the GPR traffic census and the KPD national access point in the catalogue.
